title: Groups
intro: Groups such as a SteerCo receive approvals and tasks routed to a governance role.
noPermissionNote: Membership grants no access rights: access still comes only from role assignments. A group can decide a business approval only through members who hold the approval right.
readOnly: Your roles do not allow managing groups. You can view them.

list.title: Groups
list.emptyBody: Create a group, for example a SteerCo, then map a governance role to it in a transformation.

create.title: Create a group
create.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, for example STEERCO.

member.title: Members
member.intro: A member counts for routing between the start and the end of the membership.
member.addDescription: Times are local times in {{tz}}. Leave the start empty for now and the end empty for no end.

roleMappings.title: Role mapping
roleMappings.intro: Who holds each governance role in this transformation. Approvals and tasks for a role go to the mapped person or group.
roleMappings.routingRule: A role that is not mapped is a routing error: an approval for it is refused and nothing is sent. There is no fallback to another person.
roleMappings.unmappedCount: Roles without a mapping: {{count}}. Approvals routed to them will be refused.
roleMappings.mapDescription: Choose one person from the team or one group. A group receives approvals only if a current member holds the approval right.
roleMappings.endDescription: The role becomes unmapped: approvals routed to it are refused until it is mapped again.
